evidence.testTitle: [MEDIA-001 AUTH-011 AUTH-024 DB-025] logout prevents upload commit after authenticated channel scope was paused
evidence.scenarioScope: Channel-scoped SQLite upload; disable uses a real bootstrap-provisioned administrator.
evidence.rationale: Real credentials, public upload and revocation entrypoints, production Worker SQLite and real Miniflare R2; deterministic test-only pauses.
assertionDetails: Actual getMediaScope completes, gate pauses return, logout succeeds, old token is 401, then release yields denied upload with unchanged real metadata and chunk rows.
Successful authorized upload and independent owner file remain intact; separate IRC and event observers receive live message barriers without race filename, bytes or ID.
No post-transition full recreation was performed.

evidence.testTitle: [MEDIA-009 MEDIA-012 AUTH-011 DB-025] failed R2 put releases reservation even after originating session revocation
evidence.scenarioScope: R2 put failure after session revocation; provider delete failure and process-crash recovery not tested.
evidence.rationale: Real credentials, public upload and revocation entrypoints, production Worker SQLite and real Miniflare R2; deterministic test-only pauses.
assertionDetails: After real metadata reservation, route R2 put is held by a separate Durable Object gate; logout commits and the injected put failure returns safe 503.

Pending metadata and quota are removed and real bucket contents match baseline; healthy unrelated file and subsequent upload work. A normal failed put without revocation also rolls back and ordinary uploads succeed.
IRC and event observers have positive barriers and no race identifiers; no post-transition full recreation was performed.

evidence.testTitle: [MEDIA-001 MEDIA-003 MEDIA-006 AUTH-011 DB-025] completed R2 put stays private and rolls back after logout before publication
evidence.scenarioScope: Successful R2 put held before finalization; internal RPC tests run directly via fixture with no client-facing test endpoint.
evidence.rationale: Real credentials, public upload and revocation entrypoints, production Worker SQLite and real Miniflare R2; deterministic test-only pauses.
assertionDetails: Real R2 put writes the complete object before test-only gate pauses its return; pending row remains inaccessible via public media GET to both owner and unrelated user.
Actual internal DO rollback RPC cannot remove a pending object under the wrong owner or ready objects under the matching owners; their bytes and metadata are checked.
After logout is acknowledged, release yields 403, removes pending row and completed bucket object, and leaves the independent ready object intact; live IRC/event barriers show no race identifiers.
No post-transition full recreation was performed.
